existing_tips: Regular -ar past: morar → morei (eu). 'Por dois anos' = for two years – 'por' for duration.
'Haverá' is the future of 'haver' – used formally for 'there will be'.
In formal Portuguese, 'de quem' is used with verbs requiring 'de': gostar de.
'Se pudesse' introduces a hypothetical ability – paired with the conditional for the imagined result
A common Brazilian proverb using 'quem' – 'whoever doesn't risk, doesn't snack'.
